description: In a 0.1 document FS_furniture's top-level "collections" is opaque data that would be malformed in 0.2 (Core model/066). The step moves it into the record (20.4.1, 20.3.1): the migration is valid under 0.2, SOFA is no element of it, and nothing is derived from it, as in the document (20.6.1). FS_furniture stays declared, its data {}.
